# Terra Incognita

> A living map of what humanity does not know yet: 100 great open scientific questions, linked together. For each: what we know, what blocks us, current leads, research sub-questions and typed sources (peer-reviewed study, preprint, official, press...). Seven languages: en, fr, zh, es, hi, ar, pt. Checked every week; nothing is written without a source that was actually read, and changes are re-checked by an independent verifier. Not yet reviewed by domain specialists. Last update: 2026-11-21.

## Data

- [Full dataset, all languages (JSON)](https://terraincognita.ca/data.json): questions, sources, sub-questions, change log. License CC BY 4.0.
- [Questions in en (JSON)](https://terraincognita.ca/q/en.json)
- [Questions in fr (JSON)](https://terraincognita.ca/q/fr.json)
- [Questions in zh (JSON)](https://terraincognita.ca/q/zh.json)
- [Questions in es (JSON)](https://terraincognita.ca/q/es.json)
- [Questions in hi (JSON)](https://terraincognita.ca/q/hi.json)
- [Questions in ar (JSON)](https://terraincognita.ca/q/ar.json)
- [Questions in pt (JSON)](https://terraincognita.ca/q/pt.json)
- Cite as: Terra Incognita contributors, Terra Incognita, DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24356516
